captions.detailed: A consumer-scale video camcorder with a dark matte-black finish. It features a soft-edged rectangular main housing, a stepped cylindrical camera lens assembly on the front, a power mode dial on the top rear corner, and a fold-out screen door on the left side. The screen door is designed to swing open on a vertical side hinge, and the inner screen panel can rotate on a secondary swivel pivot for flexible viewing angles.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a consumer camcorder with a rounded rectangular body shell, a cylindrical front objective lens, a top-rear mode dial, and a left-side screen door. Ensure the screen door is articulated with a vertical hinge joint, and the internal screen has a secondary swivel pivot.
captions.factory: Construct the main body housing by extruding a rounded rectangle and filleting its edges. Create the cylindrical objective lens from stepped cylinders joined to the front face. Model the mode dial as a small cylinder on the top-rear corner. Define the screen assembly with a base door panel and an inner screen, and link them using revolute joints for both the main hinge (vertical axis) and the swivel pivot (transverse axis).
